::: {#exm-tuple}
#### Tuples are not sets

- $(1, 2) \ne (2, 1)$, because their first entries differ,
  but $\set{1, 2} = \set{2, 1}$, because order does not matter in a set (@def-set).
- $(4, 4, 1)$ is a $3$-tuple whose first two entries are equal,
  but $\set{4, 4, 1} = \set{1, 4}$ has two elements.

:::
